problems: `topics:` — what is always true is the content of an always-on event

`view:` — the walk is session-only and writes nothing; every decision opens unanswered. Delete the view
`library:` is gone — every document is written into the book, under its own event
`compare:` is gone — there is no A/B view any more
`materials:` and `scales:` are gone — nothing damps a branch any more; every document is written into the book
event rules-here: `inputs:` is gone — what an event needs or captures belongs in its content

event rules-here: `sets` — an answer is taken on the rail, never by an event. Delete it

event neither: Nothing has neither `doc` nor `docs` — write the document under it
event by-unknown: `by` names zz, which is not a decision of this book

event both: the content has both `doc` and `docs` — one document, or one per answer combination
